01InfraLockIP INTELLIGENCE SERVICE+

My role: Software development

Product / Context

InfraLock brings IP geolocation, VPN and proxy signals into a web lookup experience. My work connects a Rust lookup service with a Next.js interface so network information can be reviewed in one place.

Market / Customer

Application developers and technical users evaluating IP information.

Problem

IP information needs both a lookup system and a readable interface before it is useful in a technical workflow.

Product / Service

A Rust lookup service and Next.js interface presenting IP geolocation, VPN/proxy information and threat signals. A technical lookup service accessed through a web interface.

Product Goal

Make IP lookup data accessible through a clear web interface.

My Role

Software development.

Work

I developed the Rust lookup service and its connection to the Next.js interface.

Solution

The service performs the lookup and the interface presents the resulting network context.

Outcome

A Rust lookup service connected to a Next.js interface for reviewing IP geolocation and network-risk signals.

Scope: Earlier software project with a linked repository; production deployment is not documented.

03LungeMOBILE FITNESS APPLICATION+

My role: Mobile & full-stack development

Product / Context

Lunge is a React Native and Expo fitness application for organising workouts, tracking food and reviewing progress. I developed the mobile experience across planning, logging, goals and social workflows, with AI-assisted plans and support for seven languages.

Market / Customer

People planning workouts and recording activity and nutrition over time.

Problem

Training, food intake and progress are easier to review when the records are connected in one application.

Product / Service

Workout planning and logging, food records, goals and progress statistics, plus AI-assisted plans, moderation, social functionality and seven languages. A mobile product with connected planning, logging and progress workflows.

Product Goal

Connect everyday fitness records with an understandable view of personal progress.

My Role

Mobile & full-stack development.

Work

I developed the React Native and Expo application over a year, connecting workout, food, goal, progress and social workflows.

Solution

The app brings planning, logging, goals and progress views into one mobile experience.

Outcome

A mobile fitness product bringing workout and food records together with goals, progress views and the documented social and AI-assisted features.

Scope: Earlier mobile and full-stack product work; current availability requires confirmation.

06Algorithmic ResearchQUANTITATIVE MARKET RESEARCH+

My role: Python research & system development

Product / Context

Algorithmic Research is my Python work on data analysis, backtesting and risk models, using cryptocurrency markets as a test environment. I build research tools to examine how an algorithm behaves under explicit assumptions.

Market / Customer

Developers evaluating trading strategies, data assumptions and risk behaviour.

Problem

Algorithmic ideas need a structured way to examine behaviour against data and risk assumptions.

Product / Service

Python tools for data analysis, backtesting and risk modelling. An independent research workflow built around Python analysis and strategy evaluation.

Product Goal

Make trading ideas testable and examine the assumptions behind their behaviour.

My Role

Python research & system development.

Work

Python research and system development across data analysis, backtesting and risk modelling.

Solution

Data and explicit evaluation rules turn an idea into something that can be examined systematically.

Outcome

Python research tools for examining market data, testing algorithms and evaluating risk assumptions.

Scope: Independent quantitative research; no demonstrated financial result is claimed.

I’m Adrian Enev, a Full-Stack Developer based between Dobrich and Varna, Bulgaria. My work spans website design, web and mobile applications, backend systems and algorithmic research.

I’m studying at Nikola Vaptsarov Naval Academy in Varna. I connect interface decisions with application logic, and use quantitative market research to examine data, backtesting and risk assumptions.
